gaps.desktop: The This Evening hairline in the loser starts about 5px left of the checkbox/moon column (rule at x~93, checkbox edge at x~98), so it overhangs the content edge; the winner starts it within about 3px of that column (x~77 vs 80), which keeps the section rule tied to the rows. The loser's titles also set about 0.5% wider (looser tracking) and gain nothing from it. Otherwise the rows match pixel for pixel.
gaps.phone: The loser's add button is a flat ~66px #5C9CF4 disc with effectively no elevation shadow (background is back to ~243 within 2px), pinned 16px from the right edge inside the band of the last 'Buy party decorations' row, so it reads as stuck onto the list; the winner draws a ~63px disc with a soft ~10px downward shadow, ~19px inset, floating clear of the rows. The loser's project subtitles are also a touch lighter (#A6A6A7 vs #9E9E9F).

why: Rows are near-identical at both sizes; desktop goes to the tighter section-rule alignment, phone to the properly elevated add button that stays clear of the last row.
